name: Firefox Downloads
description: Firefox downloads in the notch: progress, speed or time left, Stop, Resume, Retry, Show in Finder and Open File. No browser extension needed.

settings.title: File-Type Icons
settings.description: Show the file's extension (pdf, dmg, zip…) in the pill. Off: the pill keeps the download arrow.

settings.title: Download Details
settings.description: What follows the amount while downloading: the speed, the time left, or both, taking turns every 4 seconds.

settings.title: App Switching After Resume
settings.description: Resume has to bring the browser to the front for a moment. On: you're switched back to the app you were using right after.

settings.title: Focus Mode
settings.description: Coming in a later update. This switch does nothing yet.

settings.title: Delayed Display
settings.description: While you're away, a download that finishes, pauses, fails or is canceled doesn't open the notch. Its card opens when you're back.

settings.title: Away After
settings.description: You count as away when the screen is locked, or after this long without touching the keyboard, mouse or trackpad.

settings.title: Sneak Peek Duration
settings.description: How long the sneak peek stays open when a download finishes, pauses, fails or is canceled.

settings.title: Remain Visible
settings.description: How long the closed pill of a finished or canceled download stays after its sneak peek. At 0 it goes away together with the sneak peek.
